limitations: Shopify Global Catalog and storefront data verify only a current exact-part-number offer, never appliance compatibility.
GFE28GYNFS and GNE29GYNFS remain checks-only because their manufacturer pages list both RPWFE and XWFE without a serial-level cutoff.
KRFF305ESS00 remains checks-only because the authorized catalog presents both EDR4RXD1 and EDR2RXD1 for the same exact revision.
DLEX4000W.ABWEUUS and DLEX6500B.ABLEECI remain checks-only because their exact diagrams prove the cabinet catch, not the door-side strike inspected by Clunk.

DVE50T5300C/A3 remains checks-only because its exact service BOM exposes the cabinet holder and complete door assembly but not a separately serviceable door-side lever; DVE54CG7150D/A3 remains checks-only pending an equally exact service BOM.
LG washer revisions with multiple drain-pump rows remain checks-only; WT7400CW.ABWEUUS is promoted because its exact diagram contains one drain-pump row.
WM5500HWA remains checks-only because the stored ABWEUUS revision and the current LG support revision do not align cleanly; no suffix is normalized across that conflict.
Family-only identities remain checks-only until a complete engineering revision is separately proven.
